name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
sponsor: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) / Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
eligible_institutions: Any approved UK university or higher education institution with which the CSC has a part-funding agreement
fields_of_study: Offered under the six CSC development themes
domicile_requirements: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country, or be a British Protected Person. Be permanently resident in an eligible Commonwealth country.
merit_criteria: Candidate merit (including academic experience), quality of research proposal, and potential impact on the development of the candidate's home country.
need_criteria: Be unable to afford to study in the UK without this scholarship.
min_gpa_or_marks: By September 2027, hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard, or a lower second-class degree and a relevant postgraduate qualification (usually a Master's degree).
age_limit: There is no age limit for CSC applications.
other_conditions: The CSC funds one-year taught Master's programmes only and does not fund MBA degrees. Applicants must not have already studied at Master's level at a UK institution, or have already received a Commonwealth Scholarship at Master's level.
benefits: Approved airfare from the Scholar's home country to the UK and return, full tuition fees covered, stipend at the rate of £1,712 per month or £2,000 per month for those at universities in the London metropolitan area, study travel grant, child allowance of £622 per month for the first child and £154 per month for the second and third child under the age of 16 if eligible.
application_procedure: Applications to the CSC are made using the application system, CSC Central, alongside applying to a nominator such as a National nominating agency or selected non-governmental organisations and charitable bodies.
required_documents: Proof of citizenship or refugee status (valid passport or national ID card), full transcripts detailing all higher education qualifications with certified translations, references from at least two individuals in PDF format.
attestation_requirements: References must be on institution letterhead or an email clearly showing the sender's details and signed.
